# @pd2-trader/ui — rules for AI tools building PD2 Trader features and plugins
# Human version: DESIGN_RULES.md (same folder). Lint: eslint-rules/design-system.js + consistency.js (pd2-ds/*).
# Catalog: `npm run catalog` (Ladle; every component x 21 themes x window opacity).

## Context
- UI runs in ONE transparent, always-on-top, NON-FOCUSABLE overlay window over Diablo II (Tauri 2 + WebView2, Chromium >= 112).
- Stack: React 18, Tailwind 4, shadcn (new-york), Radix, framer-motion, lucide-react, i18next.
- 21 themes (11 dark, 10 light). Every theme defines every token, so style ONLY with tokens.

## Allowed color classes (Tailwind stems; use with bg-/text-/border-/ring-/fill-/stroke-/from-/to-; opacity suffix /10 … /90 ok)
semantic: background foreground surface surface-foreground surface-elevated card card-foreground popover popover-foreground
  primary primary-foreground secondary secondary-foreground muted muted-foreground accent accent-foreground
  destructive destructive-foreground success success-foreground warning warning-foreground info info-foreground
  border input ring scrim chart-1 chart-2 chart-3 chart-4 chart-5
  sidebar sidebar-foreground sidebar-primary sidebar-primary-foreground sidebar-accent sidebar-accent-foreground sidebar-border sidebar-ring
domain: glow q-unique q-set q-rare q-magic q-crafted q-rune q-normal q-gold q-corrupted q-corrupted-zone
  dmg-fire dmg-cold dmg-lightning dmg-poison (elemental damage text)
keywords: transparent current inherit (and currentColor in SVG)
inline styles: var(--<token>) only, e.g. style={{ color: 'var(--q-unique)' }}; color-mix(in oklab, var(--success) 20%, transparent) ok.

## Token meaning (pick by meaning, not by hue)
surface = panel body (follows window transparency); surface-elevated = tooltip/popover/toast over a panel;
card = tile in a panel; popover = Radix menu/select/popover content; muted = quiet fill, muted-foreground = secondary text/icons;
accent = hover/active row; primary = the main action; destructive = error/delete; success = sold/synced/price up;
warning = stale/partial; info = notice; border/input/ring = hairline/input border/focus; scrim = dimmer behind sheets;
glow = theme highlight (shadow-glow); q-* = Diablo II item quality colors: item names ALWAYS use their q-* color; never use q-* for non-item meaning.

## Scales
spacing: 4px scale, dynamic in Tailwind 4: any multiple of 0.25 (gap-1 gap-1.5 p-2 px-2.5 w-55=220px h-4.5=18px w-0.75=3px), fractions (top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 max-w-2/5). No brackets.
named widths (w-/min-w-/max-w-): w-control (220px settings control column) w-sidebar (300px split-panel column) w-popover (400px detail card)
  max-w-viewport (window minus 8px gutters) max-w-contained (parent minus 16px gutters).
type (ONLY these exist; text-lg/xl/3xl are reset and render unstyled):
  text-3xs 10px (dense UPPERCASE meta labels, counters, chip text only) · text-2xs 11px (captions, meta, table cells) · text-xs 12px (body)
  text-sm 13px (titles, primary values, buttons) · text-base 16px (panel hero values) · text-2xl 24px (headline numbers) · text-display 30px (one hero total)
  Uppercase eyebrow: uppercase tracking-caps. font-medium / font-semibold. Numbers: tabular-nums (PriceTag does it).
radius: rounded-xs (2px marks) rounded-sm 4 (chips) rounded-md 6 (controls, tiles) rounded-lg 8 (panels) rounded-full (pills). Derived from per-theme --radius.
elevation: shadow-panel (panels, popovers), shadow-glow (highlighted item). Not shadow-lg.
z: z-raised (sticky header) z-popup (in-panel menu/scrim) z-drawer (in-panel sidebar) z-panel (overlay panels) z-floating (portalled popovers/tooltips/dialogs).
motion: ease-out ease-spring; duration-(--dur-fast)=120ms duration-(--dur-med)=200ms duration-(--dur-slow)=300ms.
  framer presets: import { fadeIn, fadeInUp, scaleIn, slideInRight, slideInLeft, listStagger, listItem, springSnappy, springSoft, useReducedMotionSafe } from '@pd2-trader/ui'.
  Gate JS transforms with useReducedMotionSafe(); use motion-safe: for CSS animation classes.
icons: lucide-react only. size-3 (dense chip), size-3.5 (inline with text-xs), size-4 (buttons, chrome bar). Use size-*, not h-4 w-4. Decorative: aria-hidden; icon-only buttons: aria-label via i18n.

## Banned (pd2-ds lint; ERROR in src/**, packages/ui/** and plugin code)
- raw colors anywhere in TSX classes/styles/props: #fff #1a1a1a rgb() rgba() hsl() oklch() oklab() lab() lch() hwb()
- Tailwind palette classes: bg-red-500 text-zinc-400 border-white text-black/50 ring-blue-400 (any hue-step or white/black)
- arbitrary values with raw numbers on spacing/size/type/radius/border: w-[312px] text-[13px] text-[11px] p-[7px] rounded-[4px] max-h-[calc(100vh-2rem)]
  (allowed: var-only values like w-[var(--radix-popover-trigger-width)], keywords like rounded-[inherit])
- importing @radix-ui/*, radix-ui, cmdk, sonner, vaul or class-variance-authority outside packages/ui (use the @pd2-trader/ui wrappers)
- styled raw controls: <button className=…> <input className=…> <select> <textarea>, div role="button" onClick → Button / Input / Select / Textarea / Toggle
- local primitives: defining Button, Badge, DialogContent, EmptyState, PriceTag, ItemName… or calling cva()/tv() outside packages/ui (add it to the package first)
- window.alert / window.confirm / window.prompt (wedge the non-focusable window; lint no-alert)
- DOM keydown listeners for hotkeys; stealing focus on open; Promise.withResolvers and other APIs newer than Chromium 112
- hard-coded UI strings (use i18n t('...'))
Escape hatch (rare, reason required): `// ds-allow: <reason>` on the line above (JSX: {/* ds-allow: <reason> */}).

## Components (everything from ONE import: import { … } from '@pd2-trader/ui'; never deep-import files)
primitives: Button ButtonGroup Badge Card ItemCard Input Textarea Label Checkbox Switch Slider Select* Tabs* Toggle ToggleGroup* Tooltip* TooltipProvider
  Popover* DropdownMenu* Dialog* AlertDialog* Sheet* Command* (cmdk) Form* (react-hook-form) Table* ScrollArea Separator Progress Skeleton Alert Breadcrumb* Chart* Toaster toast
overlay patterns: PanelSurface (panel body, window-opacity aware) PanelChrome {title icon? actions? center? onClose? diabloFont?} (h-10 title bar, drag handle)
  HoverPopover PopoverTile PopoverKeyValue PopoverSectionTitle SettingsSection SettingsGroup SettingsRow SettingsHint SettingsSkeleton
  Banner {tone:info|warning|destructive, icon, children, actions?} EmptyState {icon?, title, description?, action?} ErrorChip {message, onRetry?} SkeletonRows {rows?}
domain: ItemName {name, quality?, runeword?} (+ itemQualityClass(quality)) RuneIcon {rune} PriceTag {amount, unit:'hr'|'rune'|'gold', rune?, trend?:'up'|'down'|'flat'}
  CurrencyAmount {amount, unit, rune?, label?, delta?, size?} DataRow {label, value} StatLine {children, range?, corrupted?}
  MarketRow {name, quality?, icon?, subtitle?, price?, meta?, onClick?, selected?} SparkChart {points, tone?, showChange?}
  formatHrAmount(n) formatAmount(n, unit) usePriceText(n, unit, rune?)
slots (what plugins render into core surfaces): SlotSection {title, children} SlotRow {label, value, tone?} SlotBadge {text, tone?} SlotText {text, tone?, size?:'sm'|'md'}
  SlotColumn SlotList {items} SlotDivider SlotAction {label, onClick, disabled?}; SlotTone = default|muted|success|warning|danger|q-unique|q-set|q-rare|q-magic|q-crafted|q-rune
runtime: cn (class merge that knows the DS scale) UiLabelsProvider/useUiLabels (translated built-in strings) PanelPortalContext
Button variants: default secondary outline ghost destructive link quiet field · sizes: default sm xs lg icon icon-sm icon-xs icon-2xs row inline
  icon button = variant="ghost" size="icon-sm"; inline text action = variant="quiet" size="inline"; clickable list row = variant="ghost" size="row" (aria-selected marks it);
  picker trigger = variant="field"; pressed filter chip = <Toggle variant="chip">; segmented choice = ToggleGroup.
Toasts/confirm in the app: import { showToast, confirmToast, undoToast } from '@/overlay'.
Tokens (TS): import { THEMES, THEME_TOKENS, SEMANTIC_TOKENS, DOMAIN_TOKENS, TYPE_SCALE, WIDTHS, EASING, DURATION_MS, Z_LAYERS } from '@pd2-trader/ui/tokens'.
Tailwind theme CSS: @import '@pd2-trader/ui/tailwind.css'.

## States
loading: <Skeleton className="h-4 w-24" /> shaped like the content, or <SkeletonRows rows={3} /> (no spinners for content).
empty: <EmptyState icon={<Search />} title=… description=… action=… />: say what is empty and the next step.
error: <Banner tone="destructive"> in-panel; <ErrorChip message=… onRetry=… /> inline; toast for transient results.
interactive: hover:bg-accent, focus = global outline-ring/50, disabled:opacity-50.

## Copy
Sentence case, short, plain, no "!". "…" for in-progress ("Opening browser…"), "·" as separator.
Errors: what happened + what to do. Use PD2 vocabulary (HR, runes, corrupted, Hell games).

## Minimal example
import { Button, DataRow, ItemName, PanelChrome, PanelSurface, PriceTag } from '@pd2-trader/ui';
<PanelSurface>
  <PanelChrome title={t('myPlugin.title')} icon={<Coins />} onClose={close} />
  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-2 text-xs">
    <ItemName name={item.name} quality={item.quality} className="font-medium" />
    <DataRow label={t('myPlugin.price')} value={<PriceTag amount={price} unit="hr" trend="up" />} />
    <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={onList}>{t('myPlugin.list')}</Button>
  </div>
</PanelSurface>
